sn1.10:1.1: Ekam antaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn1.10:2.1: Araññe viharantānaṃ || santānaṃ brahmacārinaṃ || ekabhattaṃ bhuñjamānānaṃ || kena vaṇṇo pasīdatīti || ||
sn1.10:3.1: Atītaṃ nānusocanti || nappajappanti nāgataṃ || paccuppannena yāpenti || tena vaṇṇo pasīdati || ||
sn1.10:4.1: anāgatappajappāya || atītassānusocanā || etena bālā sussanti || naḷo va harito luto ti || || Naḷavaggo pathamo ||
sn1.10:5.0: Tatr-uddānaṃ || Ogham Nimokkho Upaneyyaṃ || Accenti Katichindi ca || Jāgaram Appaṭividitā || Susammutthā Māna-kāminā || Araññe dasamo vutto || vaggo tena pavuccati || ||
